title: Julie Gilbert (board chair · 4× unicorn founder) on the NACD keynote — Eric 'so eloquently and powerfully elevated the leadership of Sol Price'
summary: A board chair and audit committee veteran names the Sol Price story as one of the two most powerful conversations of the Summit, and reads it the way the book intends: a founder who held to his obligations to customers and employees even when small compromises would have lifted short-term profit.
blockquote: Eric Ries  so eloquently and powerfully elevated the leadership of Sol Price, the 'father of warehouse retailing' and his unrelenting leadership in morals and values to the customer even when slight moves could have dramatically increased short-term profitability.
attribution_title: Board Chair, Vice Chair & Audit · 4× unicorn founder · Aspen Fellow
